description: PROP-BILL-047 cancel idempotency test (cancel-flow.test.ts lines 327-339) asserts that PAY.JP cancelSubscription is not called and result.ok is true, but does NOT verify that consumeLinkSession is called or not called on the idempotent path. Given FIND-001 (link session not consumed on idempotent path contradicting REQ-BILL-022), this test should have caught the discrepancy but lacks the assertion.
